defects.description: Incorrect grammatical case: the glossary term 'Фаза' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('переход фазы').
Incorrect grammatical case: the glossary term 'Роль' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('наличие роли Core').
Incorrect grammatical case: the glossary term 'Консенсус' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('правила консенсуса').
Incorrect grammatical case: the glossary term 'Эскалация' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('шлюзы целостности эскалации').
